content: बुध {%a.%} [बुध्-क] .²1 Wise, clever, learned. .²2 Intelligent. .²3 Waking, awaking. .{@-धः@} .²1 A wise or learned man; निपीय यस्य क्षितिरक्षिणः कथां तथाद्रियन्ते न बुधाः सुधामपि <ls>N. 1. 1</ls>. .²2 A god; <ls>N. 1. 1</ls>. .²3 A dog. .²4 The planet Mercury; रक्षत्येनं तु बुधयोगः <ls>Mu. 1. 6</ls> (where बुध has sense 1 also); <ls>R. 1. 47</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 76</ls>. .{@-धा@} Spikenard. .{@-धे@} {%ind.%} On a Wednesday.
